single_source_of_truth: This file is the one source for supported/tested versions and the expected public API surface. Derived checks and CI install the version pinned here; report drift instead of duplicating claims in prose.

evidence_classes: cli: actual no-credential --help output under the same Python interpreter
introspection: import + callable() + inspect.signature of the installed object
doc: the callable's own docstring signature line only; never the operational call contract
probe.notes: Import, CLI-help, and signature probes only. A passing import or callable check is not live functionality. A missing, failed, or timed-out required probe is a failure. Opaque proxy signatures ((*args, **kwargs)) are recorded as doc-only and never establish the operational contract. The tool never registers, evaluates, submits, or calls a wallet or production endpoint.

openforage.verification: actual no-credential CLI --help plus import/introspection of the installed public wheel, recorded by .github/scripts/check_compatibility.py
openforage.note: A tested version is a floor for the recorded evidence, not a current-PyPI assertion.

latest_observation.note: The observation workflow installs the latest wheel and records differences; it never upgrades a supported entry or a verified harness entry by string match.

documented_default_algorithm.label: docs-source-label
documented_default_algorithm.source: https://pypi.org/project/openforage/ section H (wheel METADATA) documents genetic as the stable/default template
documented_default_algorithm.note: The documented default label and the observed CLI choices label stay distinct. The installed start --help lists both choices and prints no explicit default; a documented-versus-CLI default discrepancy is reported for re-verification, never silently merged.

cli.note: Probed as [sys.executable, '-m', 'openforage.cli', ...]. The bare 'python -m openforage' entry point is unavailable on 0.2.36 (no openforage/__main__.py) and is recorded as observed gap evidence, not a required probe. CLI commands are probed from the real parser, never from prose.

openforage.templates.random_weighted.note: The installed object exposes only (*args, **kwargs); the docstring carries the generator contract. It remains the observed comparator surface; no full benchmark of it has run in this packet.

openforage.templates.genetic.note: Verified callable and accepted by --algorithm on 0.2.36; the public callable and CLI interface are observed, the internal optimizer implementation was not inspected, and no GA benchmark result is claimed anywhere in this packet.

openforage.search_templates.compose_next.signature: (prior, batch_size=100, rng=None, fresh_random_factory=None, elite_factory=None, elite_fraction=0.2, diversity_weight=1.5, parsimony_weight=0.05, max_depth=None, validator=None)
openforage.search_templates.compose_next.observed_behavior: A fresh_random_factory that returns one mapping object is accepted and the returned batch entries are copies of that mapping plus lineage='fresh_random'. A factory that is a generator (or that yields) returns an empty batch. prior entries must support .get (mappings), not bare expression objects. A non-graph payload is dropped when max_depth is supplied. The full call contract remains unproved; do not wire it into a runnable --live-run path.

openforage.search_templates.measure_grap.signature: (graph: 'Any', *, max_depth: 'int | None' = None, max_node_count: 'int | None' = None) -> 'GraphComplexity'

openforage.search_templates.generation_c.observed_behavior: The public loader output (load_function_catalog entries) does not carry the internal 'data_params' key the builder reads, so explicit graph construction is not exercised in this packet and no construction claim is made.

openforage.simulate_signal.signature: (graph, *, named_universe=None, market_id, era_number, signal_pool_name, metaparameters=None, include_correlation=True, include_mi=True, record=True, return_series=False, return_weights=False, fail_fast=True)
openforage.simulate_signal.observed_behavior: Public per-candidate simulation entry point returning a SimulationHandle immediately; status()/result()/cancel() signatures observed. Live permissions, data availability, and behavior are untested in this packet.

openforage.SimulationHandle.observed_behavior: Class present with status(self) -> SimulationStatus, result(self) (block until completion, BacktestResult or raise), cancel(self) -> None, and a product_run_id attribute.

unavailable_or_unidentified: full genetic-algorithm benchmark evidence: the genetic callable and CLI choice exist on 0.2.36, but the internal optimizer implementation was not inspected and no full GA benchmark has run in this packet
per-candidate public leaf introspection for yielded graphs

custom-template synchronous evaluator feedback inside the search callback (the public simulate_signal/SimulationHandle loop is the observed alternative; its live permissions/data/behavior are untested)
python -m openforage direct execution (no openforage/__main__.py; use python -m openforage.cli or the console script)
expected_surface.installed_skills_note: The source tree carries more skills than this wheel; run openforage.list_skills() and read exactly what is installed.

opencode.recheck: A local version observation is not harness verification. OpenCode carries partial scoped evidence in harnesses.json (distinct CLI/session identity, external-bridge queued dispatch) but its entry stays documented-unverified; re-check against the evidence standard in docs/agents/harness-verification.md, and never upgrade a verified entry by string match. A missing harness is not-applicable and is never required for normal CI; agent credentials are never needed.
